# CardNote

A lightweight SiYuan plugin for capturing Markdown card notes, extracting tags, searching cards, and optionally syncing cards to today's daily note.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run dev
```

## Build

```bash
pnpm run check
pnpm run build
```
